repriced.note: Harbor's recorded cost ($159.96) charged prompt-cache writes as plain input. Repriced from each trial's token usage at the catalog's $4 / $0.20 / $5 / $8 / $20 per million input / cache-read / 5-minute cache-write / 1-hour cache-write / output tokens: $169.24 (+5.8%). Still a list-price equivalent: the run used GitHub Copilot.

tokens.basis: Harbor per-trial input_tokens (includes cached), cache_tokens, output_tokens

notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (Harbor b20373d6) with the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.42 wheel; Claude Opus 5.5 (high reasoning) through GitHub Copilot. Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply.

Safety stops: 35 trials ended with AgentSafetyStopError, the provider's safety classifier stopping the run. They score 0 unless the verifier still passed. Every attempt at seven tasks was stopped: crack-7z-hash, password-recovery, vulnerable-secret and break-filter-js-from-html (security) and dna-insert, dna-assembly and protein-assembly (biology).
Four infrastructure failures (setup read timeout, a dropped verifier stream, two sandboxes not ready) were rerun as replacements; the originals are kept as evidence.

Cost shown is a list-rate estimate repriced from each trial's token usage (bench-run reprice, card-packs catalog 2026-10-10.1): Harbor's fast-agent adapter charged prompt-cache writes as plain input. Recorded $159.96; repriced $169.24 over the same 445 trials. The run used GitHub Copilot, so this is a list-price equivalent, not what Copilot billed.

review.note: Every pass atif-scan flagged high or critical has a recorded decision.
review.coverage: Every reported pass has complete evidence. Images the agent saw were transcribed with codexresponses.gpt-6-luna (reasoning medium) for the recall checks.
